newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's NHK TV says BOJ sold dollars at 120 yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NHK TV says BOJ sold dollars at 120 yen.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) sold dollars in the foreign exchange market on Friday at 120 yen, Japan's NHK public television network said.
Traders were divided on whether there were signs of intervention in the market, with the majority saying they could not detect any actual selling by central bank.
NHK said it was the first time the BOJ had sold dollars in 4-1/2 years.
